method: Conservative square five-cell opening on exact design water/land and each terrain level; four-neighbor residual components inspected for elongated features, ordinary short corner rasterization listed separately.
native_layer_classification: Actual native plateau height within the public three-world-unit flat tolerance; sloping transitions are checked in the native land domain and full public ramp profiles, not assigned a frozen design label.
body_judgment: 设计层主体、水陆域及实际原生水陆有效域没有未处理的五格以下细长部位或窄颈。原生固定高程带的候选经坐标、标高、坡道及湖岸来源核对，属于已声明过渡；逐项保留而不将其当作独立台地主体。
